decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that extends the core machinery range and already appears as a multi-model line, it likely still has unresolved market upside, and despite higher carrying costs than software, its close fit with the firm’s integrated plant business supports keeping it for now.

This software is close to the established offer, strategically relevant for automated precast production, and relatively inexpensive to keep on the market, so its option value under continuing uncertainty is still high.
